steps.question: Do you have a strong spark at the plug?
Does the engine have normal compression?
Did the problem happen suddenly or did the kickstarter become unusually easy?

results.mechanical-lock: Check for a seized engine, transmission lock-up, starter mechanism, or other mechanical obstruction before continuing.
results.ignition: Inspect the spark plug, cap, ignition coil, wiring, grounds, kill switch, stator/pickup, and ignition system.
results.fuel-system: Check fuel valve, fuel line, filter, carburetor/injector, float system, and fuel delivery.
results.compression-fault: Check valve clearance, valve sealing, cam timing, decompressor system, piston, rings, and head gasket.
results.timing-check: Stop repeated starting attempts and verify cam timing, timing-chain condition/tension, and crank timing before replacing parts.
results.general-check: Verify spark, fuel, compression, air supply, and ignition timing systematically before replacing components.
